page.overview:
What is Nonary Region?

The Nonary Region is a region located in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is a small continent reached by a stairway of light created at the Besaid Shore from the Four Keys of Prophecy. It is first visited in Chapter 19, "The Other Nine Wood Hills".
